draft.summary: Based on our evaluation of approved alternatives to kixie.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Approved alternatives (3) with relationship reasons — not a random category list.

sections.heading: Alternatives
sections.body:
close: relevant because Close combines calling with a pipeline CRM — better when you want dialer and deal tracking in one product; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.
amplemarket: relevant because Amplemarket is stronger when multichannel AI outbound (email/LinkedIn) matters more than power dialing and SMS; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.
apollo: relevant because Apollo is the better alternative when prospecting data and email sequences are the primary jobs rather than high-volume calling; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.

sections.heading: Decision guidance
sections.body: Use comparison pages for pairwise decisions; do not invent superiority.

faq.question: Is this alternatives page based on live vendor verification?
faq.answer: Only approved or verified facts and pricing-engine outputs in the brief may be cited. Unverified research is not treated as live vendor truth.

faq.question: Has SoftwareGlimpse personally tested kixie?
faq.answer: No. This draft is based on our evaluation of research evidence, not personal product usage.
